column2: Month ○, Day × — Clear
Today, at last...
At last, he opened his eyes!!
So many times...
So many times, so many times, I almost gave up...!
Maybe God was giving me a $$ご褒美$$ for holding on...!
But he's lost every $$記憶$$ of us...
Don't give up and it'll be okay...
Someday... something good will happen, right...?
Month △, Day ○ — Rain
When it rains...
I can't help remembering the day he lost his $$記憶$$. I hate it...
But lately I also remember warming ourselves by the fireplace, alone during the $$台風$$, so...
It leaves me feeling kind of complicated either way...
Maybe another $$台風$$ should make landfall...
But really, I don't need the weather— I just need to be more forward...!
But I...
I'm not very ladylike at all...
Month ◇, Day ◎ — Cloudy
I may be boyish, but I'm still a girl...
This year I decided I'd be brave and give him chocolate...!!
But...
I'm hopeless at anything but fish dishes— can I really make chocolate...??
I've heard women use chocolate to knock the person they like unconscious...
But would something that forceful really be okay...?
And after I knock him out, what am I supposed to do...?!
Oh, stop it! What am I thinking...!?
Month □, Day × — Clear
Today I even got to $$水浴び$$ with him...
I tried to show him that I do have a chest, at least...
Did he even notice...?
Maybe...
It actually had the opposite effect...
(Shudder)...
Oh, this kind of worrying really isn't for me...!
Maybe tonight I should just climb into his bed...
W-Wait, wait! What am I thinking!?
Month ○, Day ■ — Clear
He's been getting so much better lately...!
But maybe...
Maybe he'll say he wants to leave this house soon...!
It's true: seeing the outside might trigger the $$回復$$ of his $$記憶$$...
But... I think I'm honestly scared of the day that comes...
